title: Measuring all the noises of LLM Evals
abstract: arXiv:2512.21326v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Applying well-established statistical methods effectively to LLM evals requires consideration of model correlations and prediction noises. Leading evals often ignore data noise, have low statistical power, or make unnecessary trade-offs. We define and measure three types of noise: 1) prediction noise from generating different answers on a given question, 2) data noise from sampling questions, and 3) their combined total noise following the law of total variance. To emphasize relative comparisons and gain statistical power, we propose \emph{all-pairs comparison}, which applies paired comparison to all pairs of LLMs and measures all the noise components based on millions of question-level predictions across many evals and settings, revealing clear trends. First, most evals exhibit a characteristic and highly predictable total noise level across all model pairs. Second, paired prediction noise typically exceeds paired data noise,

translated_title: 测量大语言模型评估中的所有噪声
translated_abstract: 将成熟的统计方法有效应用于大语言模型评估，需要考虑模型间的相关性和预测噪声。主流评估往往忽略数据噪声、统计功效较低，或做出不必要的权衡。我们定义并测量了三种类型的噪声：1）在给定问题上生成不同答案所产生的预测噪声；2）抽样问题所产生的数据噪声；以及3）遵循全方差定律的两者结合的总噪声。为了强调相对比较并获得统计功效，我们提出了“全对比较”方法，该方法将配对比较应用于所有大语言模型对，并基于跨多种评估和设置的数百万条问题级预测来测量所有噪声成分，从而揭示了清晰的规律。首先，大多数评估在所有模型对上表现出特征明确且高度可预测的总噪声水平。其次，配对预测噪声通常超过配对数据噪声。
tldr: 提出“全对比较”方法，定义并测量LLM评估中的预测噪声、数据噪声和总噪声，发现总噪声水平高度可预测，且配对预测噪声通常大于配对数据噪声。
en_tdlr: Proposes an all-pairs comparison method that defines and measures prediction noise, data noise, and total noise in LLM evals, revealing that total noise is highly predictable across model pairs and paired prediction noise typically exceeds paired data noise.
